    # Dictionary to count occurrences of each remainder when divided by k
    remainder_count = defaultdict(int)

    for number in a:
        remainder = number % k
        remainder_count[remainder] += 1

    # Initialize the size of the largest k-multiple free subset
    max_subset_size = 0

    # Handle the special case where k is even
    if k % 2 == 0:
        half_k = k // 2
        # We can only take one of the numbers with remainder 0 or k/2
        max_subset_size += min(remainder_count[0], 1)
        max_subset_size += min(remainder_count[half_k], 1)
    else:
        # For odd k, we can take all numbers with remainder 0
        max_subset_size += remainder_count[0]

    # For all other remainders, we can take the maximum of the count of the remainder
    # and the count of (k - remainder)
    for remainder in range(1, (k // 2) + 1):
        if remainder != k - remainder:
            max_subset_size += max(remainder_count[remainder], remainder_count[k - remainder])

    return max_subset_size
